changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The feedback history and the account export read the words of a conversation receipt from its answer (conversation_receipt_words), which shows none once the answer or its show_feedback result is redacted. A ready export holds those words, so the erasure of the show_feedback result expires it, as the erasure of the answer does.
changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER trg_conversation_entry_changed_exports ON public.conversation_entry; CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_entry_changed_exports AFTER UPDATE OF redacted_at, edited_at ON public.conversation_entry FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.redacted_at IS NULL AND (OLD.kind IN ('USER', 'ANSWER', 'DIGEST') OR (OLD.kind = 'TOOL_RESULT' AND OLD.payload -> 'message' ->> 'toolName' = 'show_feedback')) AND (NEW.redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.edited_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.edited_at)) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.account_export_message_changed();

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER trg_conversation_entry_changed_exports ON public.conversation_entry; CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_entry_changed_exports AFTER UPDATE OF redacted_at, edited_at ON public.conversation_entry FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.redacted_at IS NULL AND OLD.kind IN ('USER', 'ANSWER', 'DIGEST') AND (NEW.redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.edited_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.edited_at)) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.account_export_message_changed();
